message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: administrative enforcement officers cleaning road, villagers obstruct. One villager (沈某乙) resisted, and another (沈某甲) beat an enforcement officer (张某甲) on the head with a fist. He later turned himself in.

What crime? Likely "故意伤害" (intentional injury) or "妨害公务". In Chinese criminal law, assaulting law enforcement officers is "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public officials in performance of duties). Also, beating a law enforcement officer causing injury could be "故意伤害罪" (if injury). The fact says he used fist to hit head. No mention of injury severity. Could be "妨害公务罪". In examples, there is "重大责任事故" for safety accidents, "非法组织卖血", etc. For assault on law enforcement, we need to see if any example includes similar. Not present. But typical classification: "妨害公务罪" (obstructing public duty). Also "故意伤害罪" if injury. The description: "用拳头殴打执法人员张某甲的头部". That is assault. The crime likely "妨害公务" (obstructing public officials). The victim is a law enforcement officer. The act is violent resistance. So answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>

Check if also "故意伤害" is appropriate. The law: If the act causes injury, it's intentional injury. But the fact doesn't specify injury, just assault. The crime of obstructing public officials includes using violence. So we choose that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>
